# Archery Technocrats Private Limited (ATPL Group)

> Archery Technocrats (ATPL Group) is a premier Indian Industry 4.0 automation and system integration engineering firm delivering warehouse management software (WMS), industrial RFID tracking, GS1 barcode serialization, machine vision AI, and shop floor automation hardware.

## Core Capabilities & Platforms
- **Warehouse Management Software (WMS)**: Perfect Store™ enterprise warehouse management with real-time SAP/Oracle ERP integration and 3D bin slotting.
- **Packaging Serialization & Traceability**: Perfect Trace™ 4-tier aggregation (Item -> Shipper -> Pallet) compliant with US-FDA DSCSA, DGFT, and 21 CFR Part 11.
- **Machine Vision & Optical Inspection**: Sub-8ms automated Pass/Fail quality inspection and high-speed pneumatic defect diverters.
- **AIDC Hardware & Systems**: Strategic alliance distributor for Honeywell, Zebra, and TSC Auto ID (industrial barcode scanners, RFID dock portals, rugged mobile computers).
- **Mobile Device Management (MDM)**: PerfectEdge MDM for zero-touch provisioning and kiosk lockdown on Android shopfloor terminals.
